entities.summary: Yellow Turban Rebellion, a transformative movement in China (25–220). Emerged from Emperor Wu adopts Confucianism as the state ideology and Construction of the Terracotta Army to guard the emperor's tomb. Catalyzed Guangwu and Cai Lun improves papermaking — one of China's Four Great Inventions.
